title: Manager, Software Engineering
description: Hands-on technical leadership role providing oversight for the configuration, development, and optimization of Commercial Technology solutions across design, build, test, deployment, and support. Based in the Milwaukee, Wisconsin office, this manager works closely with MCBC delivery teams to deliver high-quality business solutions, mentors technical leads, develops junior engineers, partners with engineering team members outside the US, supports stakeholders, and shapes global engineering standards and practices. The role solves complex technical problems and fosters continuous improvement and innovation within a fast-paced beverage company.
workArrangement: Flexible work programs supporting work-life balance, including a hybrid work model of 4 days in the office.
salary: $126,500.00 - $166,100.00 posting salary range + 15% target short term incentive. Molson Coors reports $23,000 on average spent on benefits per employee, plus paid time off including holidays, vacation days and sick days. The salary range is the amount the company, in good faith, believes it would pay for this role at the time of posting. Actual pay is based on non-discriminatory factors including required work location, previous work experience, skill set and internal equity.
responsibilities: Engage with and provide technical leadership to software delivery teams to ensure on-time, high-quality, stable delivery of software solutions that meet business requirements throughout the entire Software Development Lifecycle, covering design, build, testing, deployment and support.
Provide leadership and oversight for the configuration, development and optimization of Commercial Technology solutions.
Lead software engineers effectively, ensuring a culture of curiosity and problem solving in which team members feel motivated and empowered by their work.
Perform people management activities for a small team of IT professionals, including goal setting, people development, performance management and career management.
Mentor technical leads and develop junior engineering resources, fostering continuous improvement and innovation.
Partner with engineering team members based outside the US, support stakeholders and help shape global engineering standards and practices.
Develop technical solutions for the business and solve complex technical problems using broad and deep hands-on technical experience.
Work with external developers and engineers to ensure outsourced technical work meets standards and requirements.
Stay current with the latest trends and best practices in SaaS applications, configurations and software engineering for sales and marketing.
qualifications: Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 5 years of experience developing on cloud and Software-as-a-Service platforms for Sales and Marketing applications.
At least 2 years of experience successfully managing a team, including direct supervisory and performance management responsibility.
Proven track record successfully working across all phases of the Software Development Lifecycle to deliver high-quality technology solutions for the business.
Strong interpersonal and leadership skills, with the ability to create strong team culture, establish engineering practices and standards, and influence and guide engineering teams.
Experience working and leading teams using agile development methodologies and tools.
Strong analytical and problem solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with comfort speaking to Sr. Director+ stakeholders in technology and business roles.
Ability to collaborate with team members and stakeholders, both technical and non-technical, including internal and third-party/vendor resources.
benefits: Competitive base salary and incentive plans through the Total Rewards program.

Parental leave; health, dental and vision benefits; a 401k option with an employer match described as incredible and above market; wellness incentives and an engaging Wellness Program; and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
Generous paid time off plans, including holidays, vacation days and sick days.
Employee Resource Groups offering opportunities for volunteering, leadership experience and networking throughout the organization.
Career growth and development centered around First Choice Learning opportunities.
Community involvement, including charitable donations and activities such as building parks.
On-site Pub, access to brand clothing and swag, top events, and free beer and beverages.
Work with colleagues and partners from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a fast-paced, innovative company.
equalOpportunity: Molson Coors is an equal opportunity employer and invites applications from candidates of all backgrounds, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other characteristic.
accommodations: Candidates with a disability who believe they need a reasonable accommodation during the application or recruitment processes may email jobs@molsoncoors.com.
